Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class CreateListingService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.CreateListingService
public class CreateListingService extends Object
Task 2.3 Create New Listing, shared by the seller form and the admin's "add a listing for a seller" (Task 3.7, once it is wired). The use case (Create Listings) is implemented here: required fields are checked for the chosen type (A1), then the price (A2) or lending duration (A3), then the photos (A4, at most 6). The listing is saved as Pending Review, the admin is told it is waiting, and the seller gets a confirmation (steps 11-13).

Photos are imported only when the listing is submitted (step 8), so a cancelled form stores nothing. They are copied into the app's encrypted storage by PhotoService; the listing keeps their ids and the first one is the thumbnail.

      Posts a Sell listing (Create Listings steps 3-13).
      Parameters:
      typedPrice - the asking price exactly as typed: digits with up to two decimals (A2)
